svg.title: Request latency against prompt length, e1b and v19
svg.desc: Scatter of per-request latency against input tokens for e1b and v19, served with --compile on one RTX 3090. JevBench e1b: 230 requests, 82-3874 tokens, median 36 ms; JevBench v19: 230 requests, 82-3936 tokens, median 64 ms; JF100 e1b: 300 requests, 84-4096 tokens, median 31 ms; JF100 v19: 300 requests, 87-4096 tokens, median 60 ms
svg.text: Per request, served with --compile, one RTX 3090 under WSL2. Both panels on one scale.
JevBench· 230 tasks over HTTP, first request dropped; tokens as the server counted them
JF100· 300 requests in process; tokens counted with each model's tokenizer
JF100: nine in ten requests are under 400 tokens; 12 fill the 4,096-token window and are truncated to it.
e1b is hobson-bidi's reference. Hover a point for its request, length and latency.
